name: popsicle
headline: Semrush-Clone: Marketing Platform Frontend
short_description: Semrush is a comprehensive online visibility management and content marketing platform designed to help businesses improve their online presence and reach more customers. With powerful tools for tracking your online reputation, managing your social media accounts, and creating and distributing engaging content
author: Dhanush-Saji

sections.overview:
This Semrush-clone project is a frontend implementation showcasing the design and structure of a comprehensive online visibility management platform. It includes a home page and blog page built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, demonstrating how businesses can organize tools for reputation tracking, social media management, and content distribution. The project serves as a reference implementation for developers learning to build marketing platform interfaces.
Learning frontend web development with multi-page site structure
Understanding marketing platform UI/UX design patterns
Building portfolio projects demonstrating HTML, CSS, and JavaScript skills
Prototyping content marketing platform layouts
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Dhanush-Saji/Semrush-clone`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a Semrush-clone. Analyze the following [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Provide a detailed report on their online visibility, including domain authority, backlink profile, and top-ranking keywords. Also, suggest 5 content marketing strategies tailored to their industry.
```
Copy

```
# Online Visibility Report for [Fictional Company]
```
